_comment: Run with panta-signer/scripts/create-market.ts. Field names verified against https://docs.panta.market/api-reference/markets/quote -- they are NOT the obvious guesses.
_timing: Only quotes as a 20 USDC BREAKING market from 2026-10-07T11:30Z, when ARS v LEE falls inside the 72h window. Before that it prices as a 50 USDC standard market. Check with scripts/probe_market_cost.py.
_line: Calibrated against every finished gameweek of this season, over the top 20 players by price per position, counting only games they appeared in. FWD 8+ / MID 7+ / DEF 5+ all land in Panta's full-royalty band. A forward line of 10+ clears only 7.2% of the time, implying ~93% NO tilt, which drops creator royalty from 20% to 5%.
title: Saka 7+ points, GW6
question: Will Bukayo Saka score 7 or more Fantasy Premier League points in Gameweek 6 (Arsenal v Leeds, 10 October 2026)?
resolutionRule: Resolves YES if the official Fantasy Premier League site credits Bukayo Saka with 7 or more points for Gameweek 6, once every match in that gameweek is marked finished and bonus points are final. Resolves NO otherwise.

_notes.timestamps: ISO 8601 for readability; converted to the unix seconds the API wants. Raw integers also accepted.
_notes.marketType: breaking = 20 USDC, standard = 50 USDC. Breaking requires the event within 72h. Panta does NOT enforce that at quote time -- it accepted a breaking market 4 days out -- but the docs state the rule and Panta may cancel a non-conforming market with no creator refund. Create inside the window.
_notes.sourcesOfTruth: Both URLs point at fantasy.premierleague.com. Real-world match stats are not FPL points, and the AI Resolution Agent reads whatever source you name -- naming the wrong source misresolves every market we create.
_notes.pool: Player selection comes from the top 10-20 by ownership, price or season points -- not every player in the gameweek.
_notes.duplicate: Panta keys an active create session on wallet + question and rejects a repeat with DUPLICATE_MARKET. Run --dry-run with a THROWAWAY keypair so the operator wallet keeps no session open.
